pr_title: Fix bug when pushing to a pull request which enabled dismiss approval automatically
pr_body: Fix #25858 The option `dissmiss stale approvals` was listed on protected branch but never implemented. This PR fixes that.
pr_comments:

If a PR focuses on bug fixing, then only fix the bug.

issue_context.title: branch protection rules will not cancel old approvals after new commits submited
issue_context.body:
### Description

I set up branch protection rules half a month ago and checked the option "Dismiss stale pull request approvals when new commits are pushed", but this option did not take effect. Old approvals are not be canceled when there are new commits.

### Gitea Version

1.19.4

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

No
